title: E-commerce platform
oneLiner: Search, authentication, cart and Stripe test checkout with server-side price validation.

shots.alt: Left: terminal output of 20 concurrent checkouts on stock 5 — five 201s, fifteen 409s, stock 0, five open reservations. Right: the signed-in checkout page showing the server-computed total.
Catalog grid of seeded products with category badges, descriptions and from-prices in integer cents.
Cart with two seeded variants, per-line prices, stock and a total recomputed by the server on every request.
Admin order console showing the order state machine and a seeded REFUND_REQUIRED order with its snapshotted line items.

measured.label: Checkout latency, 50 concurrent virtual users
measured.method: k6 load/checkout.js against localhost:3000 on this Windows 11 machine, 2026-10-23, 50 VUs, 250 checkouts in a 1-minute run

measured.label: Orders created by 20 concurrent checkouts on stock 5
measured.method: npx vitest run tests/integration/checkout.oversell.test.ts, real Postgres on shop_test

invariants.claim: A forged price in the checkout body cannot change the charge
One order per (userId, idempotencyKey) under concurrent double submit
20 concurrent checkouts on stock 5 create exactly 5 orders and stock never goes negative
An amount mismatch becomes REFUND_REQUIRED, never PAID
A replayed Stripe webhook is a 200 no-op
Expired reservations release stock and cancel the order
A dropped webhook is settled by the reconciliation job

limits: Single-node PostgreSQL 16 on one Windows 11 machine; the load numbers do not transfer to a managed database or a shared runner.
k6 ran for 1 minute with 250 checkouts instead of the planned 5 minutes, so the p99 is a 250-sample estimate.
Payments are Stripe test mode at most; without a key the PaymentIntent is a local pi_local_* value and no card is charged.
No partial refunds, tax engine, shipping rates or email delivery — the refund path is all-or-nothing.
The cart is not cleared after checkout, and the storefront does not model fulfilment beyond the admin status console.
